plugins.name: lore
plugins.description: A staleness watchdog for CLAUDE.md. /lore:refresh keeps a small managed block (stack, commands, version pins) synced to the current commit. A SessionStart hook silently flags drift — many commits, a lockfile change, or weeks of staleness — so you know when to refresh.
